title: Multi-Stage Distroless Docker Optimization
summary: Reduce image footprint and CVE attack surface by 85% with Google Distroless runtime images.
code:
FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

FROM gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian12
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["app.js"]
